words.example: The meeting invite has the wrong room, so I will send a correction.
words.exampleZh: 会议邀请上的房间写错了，我会再发更正。

words.example: Did the calendar invite reach the people on the late shift?
words.exampleZh: 晚班的人收到日历邀请了吗？

words.example: The standing meeting is cancelled when the director is on leave.
words.exampleZh: 主任休假时，这次例会取消。

words.example: We arranged an ad hoc briefing when the census suddenly rose.
words.exampleZh: 在院人数突然上升时，我们安排了一次临时简报。

words.example: I use the one-on-one to hear what the roster is not showing.
words.exampleZh: 我用一对一面谈来听排班表上看不出来的情况。

words.example: The mapped drive on this PC points at a server we already retired.
words.exampleZh: 这台电脑的映射盘符还指向一台我们已经退役的服务器。

words.example: The print queue for ward labels has more than two hundred jobs waiting.
words.exampleZh: 病区标签的打印队列里还有两百多个任务在等。

words.example: The default gateway on this subnet changed during last night's work.
words.exampleZh: 昨晚施工时，这个子网的默认网关被改掉了。

words.example: The IP address on the new scanner clashes with the modality worklist host.
words.exampleZh: 新扫描仪的IP地址和设备工作列表那台主机冲突了。

words.example: The MAC address on this phone does not match the one we registered.
words.exampleZh: 这部电话的网卡地址和我们登记的那一个不一致。
